answer: Add only on a pullback toward the 50-day average; do not chase. META carries the Magnificent 7 basket almost alone after a sharp one-month run, but the last runway probe found no upside to the analyst target and its macro fit under a hostile discount rate is only neutral.
departure: The Magnificent 7 stance (Accumulate) dates from the 2026-09-24 outlook; since then the stock has run past the price the runway probe scored, which found no upside to target, so the add waits for a pullback rather than buying strength.

why.macro_fit: Quality mega cap with a neutral fit: the long-end selloff and real yields are the headwinds, the trend and growth signals the tailwinds, so the regime neither helps nor blocks it.
why.theme_price: Magnificent 7 is the one accelerating basket, and META leads it on one-month return while sitting above its 50-day and 200-day averages; the second basket, internet platforms, is Neutral and fading.
why.allowlist: Attention is heating with five longs and one short, but most of it comes from one account (posts 2102909099054944558, 2102919845411189086, 2102728538189439127): consensus, not a contrarian edge.
why.record: The 2026-09-24 runway probe scored it no_runway, failing the upside, insider and delivery gates; there is no registered verdict.

changes.tell: A tail at the 10-year auction (30-year on 10-08) pushes long-duration multiples lower and makes the 50-day pullback likely; buy that, not the strength.
Q3 results: guidance that lifts estimates enough to pass the upside gate on a rescore upgrades to Accumulate on weakness; a close below the 50-day downgrades to Trim.

gaps: The runway upside was scored at the 2026-09-24 price and has not been rescored at today's close.
